name: 担当シフトの詳細
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Edit target Image 1: LH11-0001 generated shift popover v001. Image 2 is the ORIGINAL Deputy source popover; it takes priority over the Japanese mock for icons, optical proportions, spacing and fine controls. Image 3 is the Japanese mock only for localized copy. Correct ONLY the icon fidelity and neutral overflow treatment in v001. Keep its white rounded card, forest-green gradient 保存, exact Japanese content and current coherent overall layout.
Original priority: in the central Deputy popover, the calendar is a compact FILLED calendar body with small light top rings, clock is a compact FILLED gray disk with light clock hands, break is a compact FILLED cup on a small saucer with right handle, note is a compact FILLED speech bubble with two short light horizontal marks. Reconstruct these original silhouettes faithfully as coherent slate #526173 glyphs; do not use the Japanese mock's large stroke-only calendar, hollow clock, steaming mug or empty angular speech bubble. Make these four field glyphs about 75% of the body text cap-height, optically centered in the same icon column. Use an original-style small slate category dot for 受付奉仕. Preserve the forest-green plus and a modest source-style chevron. Keep neutral avatar 山. The ellipsis button is pure white with fine neutral gray border, three slate dots, no purple/lavender tint.
Exact copy remains: 山 / 山田 太郎 / 10月18日（日） / 09:00 — 12:00 / 受付奉仕 / 休憩 30分 / 礼拝前の準備を含む / 合計 / 2時間30分 / 保存. Meiryo bold name and total, regular body 14/24, metadata 12/16 at logical 390px width, tracking 0. Do not enlarge text or alter its wrapping. Preserve total and actual times; no new data or controls. White #FFFFFF canvas and card, fine neutral edges, soft shadow, forest gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E. No other accents because no multi-category legend appears. Static raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 修正版を原画と比較して実画像確認。暦・時計・休憩カップ・注記を原参照優先の塗り形状へ修正、紫寄りの省略面を白と中立境界へ修正。日本語、日時、合計、保存・追加・省略・選択操作、余白と切れなしを確認。紫主要操作は森林緑、橙役割点は単独表示のためスレートへ。厳密なフォント同定・ピクセル一致や実操作は未検証。エージェントの画像レビューのみ、所有者承認・編集可能性・実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
